correctness.rationale: The 30 sites are normalized midpoints of icosahedron edges, with rectified hull having 20 triangular and 12 pentagonal faces; each site has spherical nearest-site Voronoi cell dual to 4 incident face-normal directions. Gnomonic projection at a site sends this cell to |x|/phi^-2+|y|/phi^-1<=1. Four congruent first-quadrant sectors and 30 sites give F(r)=30Q(r)/pi, where Q integrates 1-cos(min(r,alpha(theta))) over theta in [0,pi/2]. The gnomonic radial boundary tan(alpha)=tan(pi/10)/cos(theta-psi) produces an elementary antiderivative arcsin(cos rho sin(theta-psi)), clipping endpoints at atan(phi^-2) and atan(phi^-1). Local quadratic curvature near the first active interval produces the (r-rho)^(3/2) coefficient (40/pi)sqrt(2tan rho); triangular corner area produces the final quadratic coefficient 15a sqrt(1+b²)/(pi b). Independently reconstructed all sites and hull face counts and numerically integrated the direct gnomonic surface density at radii on all sides of thresholds; checked the local coefficient limits. These finite geometric and numeric checks support the exact analytical area and local expansions, not a theorem by sample extrapolation.
